notes: Paths: realbugs/* and harness commands are relative to the fiks root; serverCommand, testCommand, installCommand, buildCommand, suiteScope, allowedEditPaths and humanFixTests are relative to the clone (repo root). {worktree} = a checked-out head of the clone; {sha} = prefix, fix or a commit in .work/realbugs/R10.

No HTTP upstream: the memory server's state is the JSONL file named by stateEnv (MEMORY_FILE_PATH), so baseUrlEnv is empty. harness/server.ts runCase copies a case's state to a fresh temp file per run and freezes the process clock at capturedAt with the RBX preload.

The npm repo (package-lock.json) is not a pnpm repo, so SBX build.ts cannot build its per-repo image yet; installCommand + testCommand were checked offline in the SBX base image (node:22.23.3-bookworm-slim, --network none, CI=1, HOME=/tmp): prefix 9 files / 149 tests pass, fix 10 files / 153 tests pass.

The contract property is args-driven (kind readAfterWriteRequested) and is evaluated by harness/check.ts evaluateCase, not by @fiks/contracts evaluate (see contract-log.md, vocabulary gap). A repro check module should call runCase + evaluateCase on the trigger fixture and assert violations[].propertyId includes namedProperty.

The prefix's own src/memory/__tests__/tools.test.ts pins the buggy behaviour (two tests marked 'KNOWN BUG #4887') and the exact create_entities description, so any correct fix must edit that test file to keep the suite green; allowedEditPaths therefore admits src/memory/__tests__/*.ts.

humanFixTests pin the human fix's implementation (exported helpers skippedEntityNames/skippedEntitiesNotice, exact notice text and tool description); a correct fix that stores the observations instead would fail them. heldoutCommand is the direction-neutral oracle.
